verdict.rationale: An OpenAPI spec is confirmed live (metorial-probe-3) and the docs site serves clean markdown with SDK code snippets (metorial-docs-2, metorial-probe-rt-2), but there is no evidence of an interactive 'try it' console, Swagger/Redoc UI, or runnable code sandbox tied to the API reference. Missing for 10: an actual interactive API explorer UI, in-browser 'run this request' capability, and confirmation the openapi.json is rendered as a browsable interactive reference rather than a raw spec file.
